description: Features used by the weather_threshold example bundle. Built from Kalshi market data and the latest NWS observation for the relevant station.

features.name: spread_bps
features.description: Bid-ask spread in basis points of mid.

features.name: obs_temp_f
features.description: Latest NWS temperature observation for the contract's station, in Fahrenheit.

features.name: obs_age_seconds
features.description: Seconds since the NWS observation was issued. 0 if no observation is available.

features.name: minutes_to_settlement
features.description: Whole minutes until the contract's settlement window opens.
